create_GuiPlacementHelper: create a GuiPlacementHelper instance with an AppService and user index for GUI object placement
update_placement_preview: call update on GuiPlacementHelper with a ray and object ID to preview valid placement positions
snap_or_hide_object: use _snap_or_hide_object to raycast and find a collision-free position for a rigid object
configure_gravity_direction: configure GuiPlacementHelper with a custom gravity direction vector for object snapping behavior
draw_placement_circle: draw a valid or invalid placement preview circle using the GUI drawer based on placement success
